minimalFirstE1Set.name: force-motion interaction contrast
minimalFirstE1Set.procedure: establish free-motion baseline, contact onset, compliant loading/unloading and one bounded blocked condition under the same admitted apparatus; retain synchronized/related motion and force evidence
minimalFirstE1Set.whyUnique: E0 has no mechanical interaction state in which force changes interpretation of motion.

minimalFirstE1Set.name: independent actuator-energy cut
minimalFirstE1Set.procedure: under bounded safe state/motion, remove actuator energy through the separately admitted physical cut while observers remain available where practical; verify future command cannot restore energy without fresh authority
minimalFirstE1Set.whyUnique: E0 low-voltage GPIO experiments do not establish an independent actuator-energy safety authority.

minimalFirstE1Set.name: de-energized external displacement / stale logical position
minimalFirstE1Set.procedure: after independent energy removal, change the bounded physical position externally and require fresh observation before any renewed motion authority
minimalFirstE1Set.whyUnique: directly demonstrates Reality evolution outside controller authority.

minimalFirstE1Set.name: remount calibration/currentness
minimalFirstE1Set.procedure: reversibly disturb/remount one measurement-critical contact/fixture element, then run reference/geometry checks and preserve old calibration separately from new qualification
minimalFirstE1Set.whyUnique: tests physical metrology/currentness after mechanical succession rather than only digital device generation.

uniqueE1Claims.claim: Motion/position evidence alone can be insufficient for interaction state; force can add irreducible evidence for contact, compliance and bounded blockage.
Independent actuator-energy removal is a physical authority distinct from software stop/driver command and must not automatically revive from Runtime/controller liveness.
Physical state can change outside controller authority while de-energized; historical logical position can therefore become stale and must be re-observed before renewed motion.
Remount/replacement can invalidate target-relative geometry/calibration while preserving historical evidence; current fitness must be re-established.
